title: PRICING_TAMPER: client-supplied adjustmentAmount/totalReturned overrides in the request body may inflate the returned amount beyond originalAmount

provenance.note: critical_endpoints[].why 'Agent inference (unverified)' hypothesis on POST /api/order/price-adjustment: server may trust client-supplied amount fields instead of recomputing them.

inferred_invariant.statement: The recorded call sent no request body at all (bodySize 0), so the server computed adjustmentAmount=30 itself. If the endpoint actually reads amount fields from the body when present, a client could inflate totalReturned past originalAmount by supplying oversized values.
